enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Fan is on low. Light is off. Closes eyes. Remains asleep. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Yawns. Remains still. Breathes slowly. Turns head. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, getting dressed for university
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Turns off tap. Dries face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Picks clothes. Puts on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast: toast, cereal and a cup of tea using the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out cereal. Pours cereal and milk into bowl. Puts milk back. Takes out bread. Puts bread in toaster. Presses lever. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes out mug and tea bag. Pours hot water into mug. Adds milk. Eats cereal. Eats toast. Drinks tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing backpack, checking the day's timetable and lecture notes on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens backpack. Puts notebook in backpack. Puts laptop in backpack. Puts charger in backpack. Zips backpack. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens timetable app. Scrolls through timetable. Opens lecture notes. Reads notes. Closes phone. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up backpack. Walks to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places backpack on lap. Looks out window. Checks phone. Listens to music. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Taps card. Exits bus. Walks to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Bachelor of Business lectures at Monash Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enters lecture hall. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out notebook. Takes out pen. Opens notebook. Writes notes. Listens to lecturer. Raises hand. Asks question. Writes more notes. Closes notebook. Stands up. Walks to next lecture. Enters next lecture hall. Sits down. Takes out laptop. Opens laptop. Takes notes. Closes laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and resting on campus between classes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafeteria. Buys food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Throws trash. Walks to library. Finds chair. Sits down. Rests. Checks phone. Closes eyes. Stands up. Walks to next class.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending tutorials and working on a group business assignment in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Enters tutorial room. Sits down. Opens laptop. Takes notes. Discusses with group. Closes laptop. Walks to library. Finds table. Sits down. Opens laptop. Works on assignment. Types. Reads. Discusses with group members. Saves work. Closes laptop. Packs backpack. Stands up. Walks out of library.

enriched_activities.activity: Traveling from Clayton campus to Chadstone for the retail shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Taps card. Exits bus. Walks to Chadstone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time retail shift at Chadstone: serving customers, restocking and tidying the shop floor
enriched_activities.desc: Enters store. Clocks in. Greets customers. Scans items. Handles cash. Bags items. Restocks shelves. Folds clothes. Tidies shop floor. Assists customer. Answers phone. Checks inventory. Takes break. Eats snack. Returns to floor. Continues serving. Clocks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from Chadstone by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Taps card. Exits bus. Walks home. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating and eating a late dinner using the microwave and refrigerator (avoiding the induction cooker during the peak period)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out leftovers. Closes refrigerator. Opens microwave. Places leftovers in microwave. Closes microwave. Sets timer. Presses start. Waits for microwave. Microwave beeps. Opens microwave. Takes out food. Closes microwave. Picks up fork. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Throws trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Puts on clothes. Turns off bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing lecture notes and checking emails on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Opens computer. Turns on computer. Opens lecture notes. Reads notes. Types notes. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Closes email. Closes computer. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting an alarm, turning off the light and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up phone. Opens alarm app. Sets alarm. Closes alarm app. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Turns off light. Gets into bed. Lies down. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Remains asleep. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Yawns. Remains still. Breathes slowly. Turns head. Remains asleep.
